From 8bd719587d1215dad42d48d725eb1858987112c8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marta Lofstedt <marta.lofstedt@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Aug 2017 15:18:10 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: Beef up of Beef up the IPS vs. CRC workaround
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit 6e644626945c ("drm/i915: Beef up the IPS vs. CRC
workaround") was supposed to solve below bug. However, the
patch I tested is not the same as the one that got merged.
With this addition the test pass.

V2: removed unused: "struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc"

Fixes: 6e644626945c ("drm/i915: Beef up the IPS vs. CRC workaround")
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=101664
Signed-off-by: Marta Lofstedt <marta.lofstedt@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20170828121810.13112-1-marta.lofstedt@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
index 4e22bb927fed..96043a51c1bf 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
@@ -919,7 +919,6 @@ int intel_crtc_set_crc_source(struct drm_crtc *crtc, const char *source_name,
 {
 	struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = crtc->dev->dev_private;
 	struct intel_pipe_crc *pipe_crc = &dev_priv->pipe_crc[crtc->index];
-	struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc = to_intel_crtc(crtc);
 	enum intel_display_power_domain power_domain;
 	enum intel_pipe_crc_source source;
 	u32 val = 0; /* shut up gcc */
@@ -951,8 +950,6 @@ int intel_crtc_set_crc_source(struct drm_crtc *crtc, const char *source_name,
 		else if ((IS_HASWELL(dev_priv) ||
 			  IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv)) && crtc->index == PIPE_A)
 			hsw_pipe_A_crc_wa(dev_priv, false);
-
-		hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);
 	}
 
 	pipe_crc->skipped = 0;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c`**
   - **Removed Line**: The line that initializes `struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc` has been removed. This variable was previously used to hold a reference to the `intel_crtc` structure derived from the `crtc` parameter.
   - **Removed Function Call**: The call to `hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);` has also been removed, which suggests that the enabling of IPS (Intelligent Power Saving) for the `intel_crtc` is no longer performed in this function.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `intel_pipe_crc.c` file are aimed at refining the workaround for the IPS vs. CRC issue. By removing the unused `intel_crtc` variable and the associated function call to enable IPS, the patch simplifies the code and potentially resolves conflicts or bugs related to the previous implementation. This change is part of a broader effort to address a specific bug identified in the referenced Bugzilla report, which indicates that the previous patch (commit 6e644626945c) did not function as intended. The removal of these lines suggests a shift in how the workaround is applied, likely leading to improved functionality in the context of the IPS and CRC interaction.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
// struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc = to_intel_crtc(crtc); // removed
// hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc); // removed
```
Reason:
By removing the unused `intel_crtc` variable and the call to `hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);`, the patch eliminates the conflict between the IPS feature and the CRC operations. This ensures that the IPS feature operates correctly without interfering with the CRC functionality, thereby resolving the test failures.
